Extracts favicon link tags including apple-touch-icon

```elixir title="Elixir"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(nil)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(length(result.metadata.favicons))
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.metadata.favicons, 0).rel)
```
